system.description:
As part of the requirements of this jutsu, you must be Feral. You perform a much more devastating variation of the tunneling fang, but in tandem with your Nin-Dog. Your dog, if not already, transforms into a Beast-Human clone and locks hands with you. You both begin to spin in tandem with each other, creating a cyclone of fangs and claws. You cannot cast this jutsu if you are in your Two-Headed Wolf form.

All creatures, in a 10-foot wide, 60-foot-long line, originating from you, must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage] if using a weapon) + your Nin-Dogs Bite damage + 5d6 piercing damage and has their defenses shredded, as their AC and DR are both reduced by 2, until the beginning of your next turn on a failed save, or half as much damage and no further effects on a success.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6 and the AC and DR shred by +1.
